description: EQT Corporation is a vertically integrated natural gas company with upstream, gathering and transmission operations focused in the Appalachian Basin, and as of December 31, 2025 it had 28.0 Tcfe of proved natural gas, NGLs and oil reserves across approximately 2.3 million gross acres and approximately 2,945 miles of pipeline infrastructure, plus an investment in Series A of Mountain Valley Pipeline, LLC, which owns the 303-mile-long Mountain Valley Pipeline spanning from Wetzel County, West Virginia to Pittsylvania County, Virginia. Its core business strategy is to be the leading low-cost producer of natural gas with a business model designed to generate durable free cash flow across commodity price cycles, relying on its substantial inventory of core drilling locations, its vast midstream infrastructure spanning the Appalachian Basin, its investment grade credit metrics, the low emissions profile of its operations and its best-in-class team and culture.
